We need propose retrosynthesis route up to 3 steps, leaves must be commercially available chemicals, total price <=9999 (we can't check price but assume typical). Need to produce target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Structure: a tolyl sulfonamide attached to phenyl with a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline.

We can think disconnection: sulfonamide formation between tolyl amine (p-toluidine) and sulfonyl chloride derived from sulfonyl aryl (maybe benzenesulfonyl chloride with para substituent). Actually target has NS(=O)(=O) attached to phenyl ring (the second phenyl). So sulfonyl group attached to tolyl amine: p-toluidine (4-methyl aniline) reacting with sulfonyl chloride of 4-(... )-phenylsulfonyl chloride? Wait the sulfonyl group is attached to the second phenyl which also bears the unsaturated amide side chain. So we need sulfonyl chloride: 4-(C=C-C(=O)N-Ph-NH2) phenyl sulfonyl chloride? Actually the sulfonyl group is attached to phenyl ring that also has the side chain. So we could disconnect at sulfonamide bond: precursor A = p-toluidine (commercial). Precursor B = 4-(C=C-C(=O)N-Ph-NH2) phenyl sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonyl fluoride). Might be expensive but maybe available? Could also reverse: start from sulfonyl chloride (4-bromophenylsulfonyl chloride) then later substitute? But need final side chain.

Alternative disconnection: amide formation between aniline (c3ccccc3N) and α,β-unsaturated acid (cinnamic acid derivative). The side chain is /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH2 attached to phenyl ring (the second phenyl). So we can disconnect amide: precursor C = aniline (commercial). Precursor D = trans-4-(4-sulfonyl phenyl) cinnamic acid? Actually the amide is attached to the phenyl ring via the carbonyl: C(=O)N-Ph-NH2. So the acid part is trans-4-(sulfonyl phenyl) cinnamic acid (i.e., 4-(phenylsulfonyl) cinnamic acid). That could be made via Heck coupling of 4-bromophenylsulfonyl? Might be complex.

Simplify: Use three steps: 1) Form sulfonamide between p-toluidine and 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride? But need the phenyl with side chain attached later.

Better: Step1: Suzuki coupling to attach side chain to phenyl sulfonyl chloride? Might be too many steps.

Given limited time, propose route using commercially available building blocks: p-toluidine, 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride, trans-cinnamic acid, aniline.

But we need final product: p-tolyl-sulfonamide attached to phenyl which has trans-cinnamoyl anilide.

We could do: 1) Prepare sulfonyl chloride: 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride (commercial). React with p-toluidine to give sulfonamide (p-tolyl-sulfonamide with bromophenyl). 2) Perform Suzuki coupling of bromophenyl sulfonamide with phenylboronic acid bearing aniline? Actually need to attach the side chain onto that phenyl: we need to replace bromine with trans-4-aminophenylacrylamide? Could do Heck coupling with trans-4-aminocinnamic acid? Might be messy.

Alternative: Build phenyl with side chain first, then sulfonyl chloride then sulfonamide.

Step1: Synthesize 4-(trans-cinnamoylamino)benzenesulfonyl chloride from commercially available 4-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride? Actually 4-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride is commercial? Might be.

If we have 4-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride, we can acylate its amine with trans-cinnamic acid (via amide coupling) to give 4-(cinnamoylamido)benzenesulfonyl chloride. Then react with p-toluidine to give final product. That's two steps.

Check availability: 4-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride (also called sulfonyl chloride with para-amine). Might be available. If not, we could use 4-aminobenzenesulfonic acid then convert to chloride (costly). Assume available.

Also need trans-cinnamic acid (commercial). p-toluidine (commercial). So route:

Step1 (retrosynthesis): Disconnection of sulfonamide bond: target -> p-toluidine + 4-(C=C-C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)benzenesulfonyl chloride.

Step2: Disconnection of amide bond: 4-(C=C-C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)benzenesulfonyl chloride -> trans-cinnamic acid + aniline (c3ccccc3N) to form amide, then attach to sulfonyl chloride? Actually the sulfonyl chloride remains attached to phenyl; we need to form amide on that phenyl's para position? Wait the amide is attached to the phenyl via carbonyl attached to the phenyl at para position? The SMILES: ...c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2. So the phenyl (c2) has a para substituent which is the trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached directly to the phenyl carbon (aryl-alkenyl carbonyl). So the phenyl is attached to the carbonyl carbon via the double bond: phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2. So the phenyl is attached to the alkene carbon (the β carbon). So the phenyl is part of the cinnamoyl moiety. So the phenyl is the aryl of cinnamic acid. So the sulfonyl phenyl is the same phenyl as the cinnamoyl phenyl. So the sulfonyl chloride is on the same phenyl that bears the cinnamoyl group at para position? Actually the SMILES: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 attached to sulfonyl group at position 1 (the sulfonyl attached to the phenyl via S(=O)(=O) attached to the phenyl). So the phenyl has two para substituents: sulfonyl attached at position 1 (connected to S) and the cinnamoyl at position 4 (para). So we need a 4-substituted benzenesulfonyl chloride with a para cinnamoyl group.

Thus step: start from 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride, do Suzuki coupling with trans-4-aminophenylacrylate? Not.

Better: Use 4-iodobenzenesulfonyl chloride (commercial) then perform Heck coupling with trans-cinnamic acid? Actually Heck couples aryl halide with alkene. Could couple 4-iodobenzenesulfonyl chloride with trans-1-phenyl-2-propenyl? Wait we need to attach the cinnamoyl chain (aryl-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2). Could do Suzuki coupling of 4-iodobenzenesulfonyl chloride with (E)-3-(phenylamino)acrylate boronic acid? Complex.

Given time constraints, propose a plausible three-step route using available reagents, even if not perfect.

We can propose:

Step1: Form amide between trans-cinnamic acid and aniline to give trans-cinnamoylaniline (C=CC(=O)Nc1ccccc1). This is commercially available maybe but we can synthesize.

Step2: Perform Friedel-Crafts acylation of p-toluidine sulfonyl chloride? Not.

Alternative: Use sulfonyl chloride with para-alkenyl group already present: 4-(E)-cinnamoylbenzenesulfonyl chloride (commercial?). Might be available. If so, only need sulfonamide formation with p-toluidine. That would be one step.

Assume 4-(E)-cinnamoylbenzenesulfonyl chloride is commercially available. Then final product via sulfonamide coupling with p-toluidine. Leaves: p-toluidine and 4-(E)-cinnamoylbenzenesulfonyl chloride (both buyable). That's one step, within limit.

But need to verify buyability. Let's check is_buyable for that SMILES: O=S(=O)(Cl)C1=CC=C(C=CC(=O)Nc2ccccc2)C=C1? Actually sulfonyl chloride with para-cinnamoyl. SMILES: O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccc(cc1)/C=C/C(=O)Nc2ccccc2. Let's test.
